gaps.sentence: She opened the letter ___ trembling hands.
The refugees were admitted ___ the country on humanitarian grounds.
___ terms of quality, the cheaper model wins.
___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
She resigned ___ the grounds of ill health.
gaps.explanation: 'on the grounds of' = for the reason of.

gaps.sentence: He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'in the care of' = looked after by.

gaps.sentence: The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.
